Email a password reset link, valid 30 minutes, to the user with this email (or
keep it for an admin to share when SMTP is off). The answer is the same whether or
not the email belongs to a user, and comes before any email is sent, so neither its
content nor its timing tells.

202.description: Always, whether or not a user has this email.

Set a new password with the token from a reset link. The link stops working, and
every session of the user ends: they sign in again with the new password.

Which email an invitation link is for, while it can still be accepted (400
``invalid_invitation`` otherwise). The token travels in the body, never the URL.

Accept an invitation with the token from its link: creates the account (with the
invited email, this display name and password) and signs it in. Works whether or not
self-registration is open; the link then stops working.

Create a user with a temporary password (admins only). Until they change it, the
user can do nothing but read ``/me``, change the password and sign out. Recorded as a
security event.

patch.description:
Promote or demote, deactivate or reactivate a user (admins only). The last active
admin can be neither demoted nor deactivated (409 ``last_admin``). Each change is
recorded as a security event.

post.description:
Answer a suspected compromise (admins only): every session of the user ends, their
password stops working, and they get a reset link. A deactivated user's cannot be
reset (409 ``user_deactivated``). Recorded as a security event.

Invite someone by email (admins only): they get a link, valid 7 days, to choose a
display name and password and join, even while self-registration is off. An email
that has an account already is refused (409 ``email_taken``); a pending invitation
to the same email is replaced. Recorded as a security event.

dataset name per Layer, naming rules and date-dimension settings. 422
`invalid_data_warehouse` if a name breaks the platform's rules; 409 `already_set_up`
the second time.

the target platform is for owners (403 for an editor). 404 `not_set_up` before setup.

Where the Workspace's work stands: Source Analysis per Source System, KPIs and
DW Modeling per Layer. Every member sees the same.

lists: a Workspace has a team's worth of members, and the list is sorted by display
name, which lives with the users.

post.description:
Add someone by email with a role (owners only). If no account has the email, they
are invited into the Workspace instead (`outcome: invited`): only admins may invite,
or anyone while self-registration is open to that email (403 `invite_not_allowed`
otherwise). 409 `already_member` if they are a member.

patch.description:
Change a member's role (owners only). 409 `last_owner` if it would leave the
Workspace without an owner.

delete.description:
Remove a member (owners only); their access ends at once. 409 `last_owner` for
the last owner.

post.description:
Leave the Workspace (any member). The last owner cannot (409 `last_owner`):
make someone else an owner first.

Hand ownership to another member (owners only): they become an owner and you an
editor. Returns the Workspace as you now see it.

get.description:
Who changed what in the Workspace and when, newest first (any member, viewers
included; 404 for anyone else).
